lines: Charactry PLUS now activates with a license key instead of a valid_hashes.js file — buy PLUS and your key arrives by email. Enter it once in Settings to activate, no file imports needed.
Licenses now support up to 2 active devices at once, with a one-click Deactivate to free a slot on an old device.
Activation checks in with the license server and caches a successful check for up to 7 days, so short outages won't knock PLUS offline.
Story Spark (AI Studio) — Generate buttons fixed across Writing Prompts, Lore Expander & Echo Lines.
Two New Plugins — “Font and Logo Maker” have joined the plugin library.
Multi-Language UI Support — the full interface is now translatable. Switch language anytime in Settings → Language. Menus, labels, dropdowns, placeholders & the Stories editor are all covered.

Plugin System — extend Charactry with popup plugin windows. Plugins appear in the sidebar automatically. Bundled: Age Calculator, Name Generator, Smart Tags, Templates, Story Bible Export, Playlist Sync, Gallery Pro, Mood Board, AI Memory Expansion, Theme Packs, Card Frame Packs.
Lorebooks — keyword-matched world knowledge injected into Character Brain AI sessions. Plugins can bundle their own.
Charactry PLUS — a premium tier unlocking Rel. Graph, Lore Map, Statistics, Personality Radar, Compare, Fusion Generator, Interaction Simulator, AI Memory Expansion & PLUS-tier plugins.
AI Studio & Character Brain — powered by Ollama (local AI). Chat with your characters using their full lore as context. Lorebooks inject world knowledge into every Brain session.
Theme Packs — 18 curated themes (Dark Academia, Cyberpunk, Cottagecore, Vaporwave & more). Drop an image to generate a palette with the eyedropper tool. Save as your own theme.
Card Frame Packs — animated, seasonal & minimal card borders. Upload your own transparent PNG frame (175 x 250 px).
Dashboard — stats row, worldbuilding counts, recently updated characters & full quick-action grid.
Characters, Folders, Universes, Lore Notes, Stories.
Worldbuilding — Worlds, Locations, Factions, Species, Magic Systems & Timeline.
Relationship Graph, Lore Map, Personality Radar, Character Compare, Fusion Generator, Interaction Simulator.
OC / AU Generators, Randomizer, Writing Prompts.
Statistics, Activity log, Tags, Search, Favorites.
Fully customizable accent & theme system.
Export / Import / full data backup support.
